intro: Music is the one non-negotiable no matter how I am to feel, to cherish that and the songs that play the miniscule role in shaping who I am, I am creating this authentic web-page, you're welcome to linger. Note that neither me nor should you take this space too seriously. Nothing is critically acclaimed, everything is personal.

personal.label: Personal
personal.description: Songs that got tangled with memory, body, recovery, desire or some version of me.

bassline.label: Bassline
bassline.description: the type'a bass that makes you zone out and vibe in. Click and figure out what makes each song special

ulas.label: Ulaş's Selection
ulas.description: the ever changing list of songs that I hand-picked for you to delve into

dreamy.label: Dreamy
dreamy.description: A song carries the potential to make you feel like you're not breathing the same air for its duration, these songs make full use of that potential and promise to be packed with their own atmosphere.

bite.label: Bite
bite.description: Careful, these songs have teeth! But they're quite fun to listen to if you keep your distance. Please do not feed them, though.

pop.label: POP
pop.description: Uplifting, beautifully mixed, stupid but with identity

distortion.label: Distortion
distortion.description: Tracks that let the riffs breathe, sometimes so much so that you won't hear the lyrics. But that's part of the fun, right?

section_info.Charge: The force, momentum or emotional voltage the song carries.
section_info.Sonical Attraction: The sounds, textures and production details that pull me back.
section_info.Lyric/Vocal Detail: Words, delivery and voices that stay with me.
section_info.Version of ulaş: The version of me this song holds, recalls or calls forward.
section_info.Lore: The history, context and memories gathered around the song.
section_info.Reading: What I hear the song saying, implying or becoming.
section_info.Comment: Anything that refuses a cleaner category.
